# FG-LLM-0001

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`llm-gateway`](../../ops/runbooks/llm-gateway.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `llm_unavailable_is_an_error_never_a_success` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: AI（ローカル LLM）に今つながりません。AI の助言なしで続けられます。
- en: The AI (local LLM) cannot be reached right now. You can continue without the AI advice.
- id: AI (LLM lokal) tidak dapat dihubungi saat ini. Anda dapat melanjutkan tanpa saran AI.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 19 §8.1 (ADR-0039): the gateway could not get an answer from the in-house Ollama (`llm.endpoint`): `reason` = `connect` / `connect_timeout` (nothing listens, the host is down), `timeout` (no answer within `llm.timeout_ms`), `gateway_timeout` (the whole checked call, two attempts, took longer than twice the timeout plus 5 s), `status_<code>` (Ollama answered an error — 500 is typically out of GPU memory, e.g. while the `gpu-eval` bench holds the GPU; 404 the model is not pulled), `body_too_large`, `body_invalid`, `redirect`, `request`. Also raised by the background model check when `/api/tags` cannot be read. The request is recorded `failed`; nothing else stops — the advice screens fall back to the view without AI and a check built on it is `error`, never success (ADR-0003).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs `forge.llm.request_finished` with `error_code=FG-LLM-0001`, `reason`, `purpose`, `llm_request_id`, `model`; the model check logs it with `task=llm_model_check` once per streak. Metrics: `forge_llm_requests_total{outcome="FG-LLM-0001"}`. From the worker host (read-only): `curl -s <llm.endpoint>/api/tags`, `nvidia-smi` (GPU memory), Kanflow's own Ollama status. `SELECT state, error_code, count(*) FROM forge.llm_requests WHERE queued_at > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY 1, 2`.

## 対処 (fix)

Runbook llm-gateway: bring Ollama back (the Kanflow side owns the process), free the GPU (the bench runs at night), or pull the pinned model. Requests are not retried by the gateway; the feature that asked retries on its own schedule. If it lasts, pause the gateway (`llm.paused = true`, an approved runbook step in production).
